description: This file `http_date.c` handles HTTP date manipulation, including parsing and formatting HTTP date strings according to various RFC standards (RFC7231, RFC 850, and asctime). It provides functions to parse date strings into `struct tm`, format date values into HTTP date strings, and check modification times.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ const char * http_date_parse_RFC_850(const char * s,struct tm * const tm)
methods.description: Parses RFC 850 date format strings into a `struct tm` structure, handling two-digit years and adjusting for years greater than 50 years in the future.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ const char * http_date_parse_asctime(const char * const s,struct tm * const tm)
methods.description: Parses asctime() format date strings into a `struct tm` structure.

methods.name: const char * http_date_parse_IMF_fixdate(const char * const s,struct tm * const tm)
methods.description: Parses IMF-fixdate format strings into a `struct tm` structure.

methods.name: const char * http_date_str_to_tm(const char * const s,const uint32_t len,struct tm * const tm)
methods.description: Attempts to parse an HTTP date string in multiple formats (RFC 822, RFC 850, asctime) into `struct tm`.

methods.name: uint32_t http_date_time_to_str(char * const s,const size_t sz,const unix_time64_t t)
methods.description: Formats a Unix time value into an HTTP date string according to IMF-fixdate format.

methods.name: int http_date_if_modified_since(const char * const ifmod,const uint32_t ifmodlen,const unix_time64_t lmtime)
methods.description: Checks if a resource has been modified since the given HTTP 'If-Modified-Since' date string.
